# Hanjin Jang, MD

> English academic physician profile and spine education website for Hanjin Jang, MD, Founder and Chief Director of New Standard Hospital in Yongin, South Korea.

Canonical website: https://www.hanjinjangspine1.com/
Official hospital website: https://new-standard.co.kr/

## Content boundaries

- Most of this website is physician-facing academic and professional education.
- `/patient-education` is a separately labeled English patient-education collection.
- Patient pages provide general education, not patient-specific medical advice or outcome promises.
- Clinical decisions require correlation of symptoms, neurologic findings, function, imaging, previous care, and individual risk.
- AI-generated 3D illustrations are labeled as educational concepts and are not actual patients, actual operations, or before-and-after results.
